challenge: NodeKit primitives did not provide one inspectable local agent-run product journey.
observedFailure: Researchers had to manually combine process output, identity, status, graphs, and screenshots, so runs were easy to lose or mislabel.
resolution: Add one bounded command that records stable identity, honest process state, exact bounded I/O, a serialized graph, a JSON receipt, and a responsive static report.
knownLimitations: The recorder observes the direct process boundary and is not a hosted telemetry service.
